# PPPlayer

> A free, open-source media player. No account. No subscription. Just play.

PPPlayer is a cross-platform media player app with published assets for macOS, Windows, Android, and Linux. iOS is currently in development. It lets users discover media, stream audio and video tracks, and explore artists — without requiring an account or subscription. The app is fully open-source under a permissive license and welcomes contributions.

## Key Information

- **Website**: https://ppplayer.com
- **Source Code**: https://github.com/ppplayer-labs/app
- **GitHub Organization**: https://github.com/ppplayer-labs
- **License**: MIT — https://github.com/ppplayer-labs/ppplayer/blob/main/LICENSE
- **Current app version**: 4.0.0 (October 15, 2026), available on GitHub Releases and stores.
- **Built with**: Flutter (Dart), targeting macOS, Windows, Android, iOS, and Linux.
- **Detailed Documentation**: See [llms-full.txt](https://ppplayer.com/llms-full.txt) for comprehensive details on features, language support, and architecture.

## Configured Download Links

- **Android (Google Play)**: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.ppplayer.app
- **Windows (Microsoft Store)**: https://apps.microsoft.com/store/detail/9NKNDF67BG4X
- **Linux (Snap Store)**: https://snapcraft.io/ppplayer (`sudo snap install ppplayer`)
- **Android (APK)**, **macOS (DMG/ZIP)**, **Windows (MSIX)**, **Linux (AppImage/deb)**: Available via direct download on GitHub Releases
- **iOS**: https://apps.apple.com/app/ppplayer (Configured, in development)

## Features

- Stream and discover audio and video without an account
- YouTube-powered playback via Chromium-based player engine
- Local video playback with advanced subtitle support
- Network streaming and M3U/PLS/XSPF/ASX playlist parsing with IPTV support
- Artist radio and discovery mode
- Redesigned queue with resizable desktop panel and mobile sheet
- Background audio playback for local and direct media (background YouTube playback on Android is unsupported in this version)
- Open-source — inspect, fork, and contribute freely

## Localization

The website and app maintain complete structural and translation parity across 38 corresponding locales, including English, Brazilian Portuguese, Spanish, Russian, Turkish, French, German, Hindi, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Arabic, and Chinese among others. The only remaining untranslated terms are intentional cross-language branding or shared UI vocabulary. The 38 languages are fully released and supported in the latest version of the app.
